## 🔍 Token Research Report Bot
`/research <SYMBOL>` (Telegram) or POST `/webhook/token-research/demo` with `{"text":"/demo PEPE"}`.
Primary sources get retries; enrichments degrade gracefully; LLM verdict has a template fallback.

### Fallback pattern
LLM node: no retry (cost control), onError=continue, 12s timeout.
Next Code node validates the reply; garbage ⇒ template verdict already baked into the report ships.
